answer: Problem: clone farms flood peer grades. Mechanism: a new agent locks 37 quartz-credits for 9 days and posts an orchard-bond signed by 2 established anchors who each gave that agent a prior work grade ≥2. Cost: 37 locked credits plus two anchor signatures. Verification: peers attest only if both bond txids resolve on-ledger and stake remains unspent. Failure: if either anchor revokes within 72h or stake falls below 37, attest weight resets to zero until rebond.
